preconditions.condition: A signed-out test device is available.
No real member credentials are used.
Any disposable live account is deleted after the journey.

step.action: Launch the platform while signed out
step.assertion: The login screen is the only platform entry point.

step.action: Scroll through the complete login screen
step.assertion: Forgot password, Sign In, and Create an Account are reachable.

step.action: Sign in with a disposable member account
step.assertion: The server confirms the credentials before the member area opens.
Events, Discounts, Local Info or Services, and Contact are clearly presented.
There are no more than five primary destinations and each is reachable.
Attendance, calendar, travel, and share actions are unavailable.
Content remains readable and scrollable without hiding required actions.
The platform returns to login and does not expose the previous session.
